new.title: Welcome to the Workbench
new.body: Click "New Template" to design your first label, or "Import Template" to import a file.

nav.title: Come Back Anytime
nav.body: Use the left navigation to switch pages; replay this tour from the bottom status bar.

new.title: Meet the Designer
new.body: Drag text, barcode and QR code from the left widget bar; set W / H in the top toolbar.

select.title: Meet Data & Print
select.body: Pick a template, fill in the data, then print; if none yet, create one in the Workbench.

excel.title: Excel Batch Printing
excel.body: Download an Excel sample sheet, one row per label; confirm each column's field on import.
